arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show edge image

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specigy queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: edge_type
arg.description: Specify edge dtection methods. 0: Sobel Derivatives, 1: Lapalace Operator, 2, Canny Edge Detector.

arg.name: apertureSize
arg.description: Aperture size for the Sobel() operator.

arg.name: apply_blur_pre
arg.description: Flag, applying Blur() to input image

arg.name: postBlurSize
arg.description: Aperture size for the Blur() to input image()

arg.name: postBlurSigma
arg.description: Sigma for the GaussianBlur() to input image.

arg.name: apply_blur_post
arg.description: Flag, applying GaussinaBlur() to output(edge) image
